title: Output pivotality for monotone functions
statement: Let $f\colon\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be monotone, let $b\in\{−1,1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate and $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The output of $f$ at $x$ equals $b$ and changing coordinate $i$ changes the output if and only if $x_i=b$ and changing coordinate $i$ changes the output.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
